name: Shared folder filing plan
summary: The office coordinator gets a plan for tidying a shared folder: a proposed folder structure, every file's move with its owner named, and the duplicates and access questions to settle first. Owners approve their own moves; nothing is moved, renamed or deleted.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own map of office filing work, written from how a coordinator tidies a shared folder: numbered filing rules where the first match decides, exact comparison of who can see a file with who can see its new folder, duplicates held for their owners, and every move approved by the document's owner.
